name: ATI Inc.
business: Specialty materials: titanium, nickel-based alloys and forgings, mainly for jet engines, airframes and defense.

news.title: Q2: FY26 guide raised (adj. EBITDA $1.135–1.185B, EPS $4.90–5.18, FCF $550–600M); record $4.4B backlog
Morgan Stanley Laguna conference: targets ~$1.35B EBITDA run-rate entering 2027

pros: Aerospace & defense ~70% of revenue; defense sales +90% y/y
Margin expansion (adj. EBITDA margin 22.6%) and pricing resets
take: Strong aerospace up-cycle story with rising margins; fundamentals back the trend, valuation leaves little room for a miss.

metrics.summary: ATI Inc. produces and sells specialty materials and complex components worldwide. It operates in two segments, High Performance Materials & Components, and Advanced Alloys & Solutions.
